Real Talk: No one can pass through Dem primaries w/o dem Black votes. Ain't Deval seen by way of Kamala & Cory that Obama-era neoliberalism ain't gonna fly no more? That skinfolk ain't kinfolk? That #BlackLivesMatter ain't got no room for a Black cop, Black Cory or Bain Capital?
